author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Tens of thousands of people have gathered in New Delhi as opposition parties demand the resignation of India's chief election commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar, over allegations of voter list manipulation.

Led by opposition leader Rahul Gandhi, protesters accuse the Election Commission of removing more than 130 million names from voter lists in a process they say could undermine electoral fairness and benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

The Election Commission says the review is intended to remove duplicate and ineligible registrations, while the BJP and the commission reject accusations of political bias.

The dispute has become a major political flashpoint, raising questions about voter access and confidence in India's electoral process.

Al Jazeera's Ishan Garg reports from New Delhi.

description:
A humanitarian mission in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky has ended. Russian forces have controlled the southern Ukrainian town since the early days of the 2022 full-scale invasion, and years of intense bombardment and deteriorating conditions have led to a humanitarian crisis.

A rare agreement between the two countries allowed hundreds of civilians to evacuate, the first operation of its kind since the war began. The mission was negotiated between Ukraine and Russia with the involvement of US First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo.

Ukraine’s ombudsman hopes the mission’s success will pave the way for more humanitarian operations. But the ceasefire is temporary, and hundreds have chosen to remain in Oleshky, where the threat of renewed fighting hangs over them.

Al Jazeera’s Audrey MacAlpine reports from the Ukraine-Belarus border.
